declare

 v_local_schedule_end_time date;

begin
 SELECT SUM( PROJECTED_DRAW )
 INTO :DRIVES.PROJECTED_DRAW
 FROM DRIVE_SPONSORS 
 WHERE DRIVE_ID = :CTRL_BLK.DRIVE_ID 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 begin
 select location_name, travel_time, locations.location_id 
 into :ctrl_blk.location, :drives.schedule_travel_time, :global.location_id
 from drives, locations
 where drive_id = :ctrl_blk.drive_id 
 and drives.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and drives.location_id = locations.location_id(+) 
 and drives.chapter_id = locations.chapter_id 
 and rownum = 1;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :ctrl_blk.location := ' ';
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 select count(*) 
 into :drives.actual_draw 
 from donations 
 where drive_id = :ctrl_blk.drive_id 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and unit_id is not null;

 calc_drive_sch_times( :ctrl_blk.drive_id, start_time, end_time, :global.chapter_id);
 :drives.schedule_leave_time := start_time;
 :drives.schedule_return_time := end_time;
 if ( :drives.actual_leave_time is null ) then
 :drives.actual_leave_time := start_time;
 end if;
 if ( :drives.actual_return_time is null ) then
 :drives.actual_return_time := end_time;
 end if;
 if ( :drives.actual_start_time is null) then
 :drives.actual_start_time := :drives.schedule_start_time;
 end if;

 :drives.travel_mins := to_date( lpad( to_char( mod( :drives.schedule_travel_time,60)), 2, '0'), 'MI');

 :drives.actual_travel_mins := to_date( lpad( to_char( mod( :drives.schedule_travel_time,60)), 2, '0'), 'MI');
 else

 :drives.actual_travel_mins := to_date( lpad( to_char( mod( :drives.actual_travel_time,60)), 2, '0'), 'MI');
 end if;
 end if; 
 if ( :drives.schedule_stup_bkdown_time is not null) then
 :drives.setup_bkdown_hrs := to_date( lpad( to_char( floor( :drives.schedule_stup_bkdown_time/60)), 2, '0'), 'HH24');
 :drives.setup_bkdown_mins := to_date( lpad( to_char( mod( :drives.schedule_stup_bkdown_time,60)), 2, '0'), 'MI');
 if ( :drives.actual_stup_bkdown_time is null) then
 :drives.actual_stup_bkdown_hrs := to_date( lpad( to_char( floor( :drives.schedule_stup_bkdown_time/60)), 2, '0'), 'HH24');
 :drives.actual_stup_bkdown_mins := to_date( lpad( to_char( mod( :drives.schedule_stup_bkdown_time,60)), 2, '0'), 'MI');
 else

 :drives.actual_stup_bkdown_mins := to_date( lpad( to_char( mod( :drives.actual_stup_bkdown_time,60)), 2, '0'), 'MI');
 end if; 
 end if;
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 01/10/2012. IM 6205
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :drives.schedule_leave_time, v_local_schedule_leave_time);
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :drives.schedule_return_time, v_local_schedule_return_time);
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :drives.schedule_start_time, v_local_schedule_start_time);
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :drives.schedule_end_time, v_local_schedule_end_time);
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :drives.actual_start_time, v_local_actual_start_time);
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :drives.actual_end_time, v_local_actual_end_time);
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :drives.actual_leave_time, v_local_actual_leave_time);
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :drives.actual_return_time, v_local_actual_return_time);
 else
 v_local_schedule_leave_time := :drives.schedule_leave_time;
 v_local_schedule_return_time := :drives.schedule_return_time;
 v_local_schedule_start_time := :drives.schedule_start_time;
 v_local_schedule_end_time := :drives.schedule_end_time;

 v_local_actual_end_time := :drives.actual_end_time;
 v_local_actual_leave_time := :drives.actual_leave_time;
 v_local_actual_return_time := :drives.actual_return_time;
 end if;
 
 :drives.schedule_leave_time := v_local_schedule_leave_time;
 :drives.schedule_return_time := v_local_schedule_return_time;
 :drives.s_schedule_start_time := v_local_schedule_start_time;
 :drives.s_schedule_end_time := v_local_schedule_end_time;
 :drives.s_actual_start_time := v_local_actual_start_time;
 :drives.s_actual_end_time := v_local_actual_end_time;
 :drives.s_actual_leave_time := v_local_actual_leave_time;
 :drives.s_actual_return_time := v_local_actual_return_time;
 
 :global.start_time := to_char(:drives.s_actual_start_time, 'mm-dd-yyyy'); -- Added by Kishore on 01/10/2012. IM 6205
 :global.end_time := to_char(:drives.s_actual_end_time, 'mm-dd-yyyy'); -- Added by Kishore on 01/10/2012. IM 6205

PROCEDURE parse_string( x_diff_string in varchar2,
 drv_id in varchar2, 
 x_staff_no in varchar2,
 chapter_id in varchar2,
 transac_flag in varchar2) IS
 x_position number;
 x_diff_code varchar2(100);
 temp_string varchar2(100);
 query_cnt number:=0;
 x_cnt number:=0;
BEGIN
 /** Parses the diff code string and accordingly inserts/updates/deletes 
 *** records into valid_diffs table **/
 x_diff_code := x_diff_string;
 temp_string := x_diff_string||',';
 if ( NVL( length( x_diff_string), 0) > 0 ) then
 if (transac_flag = 'U') then
 delete drive_emp_diffs 
 where drive_id = drv_id 
 and staff_no = x_staff_no 
 and chapter_id = chapter_id;
 end if;
 while ( NVL( length( temp_string), 0) >0) loop
 select to_number(instr(temp_string,',',1,1)) 
 into x_position 
 from dual;
 if ( x_position > 1) then
 x_diff_code := substr( temp_string, 1, x_position-1);
 select count(*) 
 into query_cnt 
 from drive_emp_diffs
 where drive_id = drv_id 
 and staff_no = x_staff_no 
 and diff_code = x_diff_code 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and rownum = 1;
 if ( query_cnt = 0 ) then
 insert into drive_emp_diffs(
 drive_id, staff_no, diff_code,
 chapter_id, insert_user, insert_date, program_id)
 values ( 
 drv_id, x_staff_no, x_diff_code,
 chapter_id, :banner.user_id, sysdate, :banner.prog_name );
 end if;
 elsif ( x_position = 0) then
 exit; 
 end if;
 temp_string := substr( temp_string, x_position+1, NVL( length( temp_string), 0)); 
 end loop;
 else /** if no diff code selected , delete existind diffs **/
 select count(*) 
 into x_cnt 
 from drive_emp_diffs 
 where drive_id = drv_id 
 and staff_no = x_staff_no 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and rownum = 1;
 if ( x_cnt = 1) then
 delete drive_emp_diffs 
 where drive_id = drv_id 
 and staff_no = x_staff_no 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

Trigger.Name: FETCH_SCHEDULE_STAFF
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 cursor cur1 is 
 select a.staff_no, a.job_code
 from staff_schedule_details a, staff_schedule_hdr b
 where a.drive_id = :ctrl_blk.drive_id 
 and a.schedule_id = b.schedule_id 
 and b.status = 'FINAL';
 loop_ctr number := 0;
begin
 go_block('drive_employees');
 for z1 in cur1 loop
 begin
 :drive_employees.staff_no := z1.staff_no;
 :drive_employees.job_code := z1.job_code;
 if (:drive_employees.job_code = 'TMLDR') then
 :drive_employees.tl_flag := 'Y';
 else
 :drive_employees.tl_flag := 'N';
 end if;
 -- :drive_employees.special_job_code := z1.special_job_code;
 begin
 select substr(first_name, 1, 15) || ' ' || substr(last_name, 1, 15)
 into :drive_employees.staff_name 
 from employees 
 where staff_no = :drive_employees.staff_no 
 and emp_class = 'MSTAF' 
 and rownum = 1;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 --message('Staff not maintained '); /* Commented by Mediware, Edwin per Goudar on 03/03/2000*/
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 exit when cur1%NOTFOUND;
 if (loop_ctr < to_number(:global.staff_cnt)) then
 next_record;
 end if;
 loop_ctr := loop_ctr +1;
 end;
 end loop;
 if (:system.cursor_record <> '1') then
 delete_record;
 end if;
 first_record;
 go_block('drives');
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
error_flag varchar2(1);
act_cpu number;
error_msg varchar2(80);
query_cnt number:=0;
begin
 :system.message_level := 10;
 /** CALCULATE THE ACTUAL CPU HERE **/
 post;
 select count(*) into query_cnt from
 drive_employees where drive_id=:ctrl_blk.drive_id and
 chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
 rownum=1;
 if(query_cnt = 0) then
 go_block('drive_employees');
 show_error('12057');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 don_cost_analysis.calc_act_cpu(:ctrl_blk.drive_id,:global.chapter_id,act_cpu,error_flag,error_msg);
 if (error_flag = 'Y') then
 show_error('12063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if ;
 :drives.actual_cpu := round(act_cpu,2);
 :ctrl_blk.drive_actuals_entered := 'Actuals Entered';
 commit_form;

 IF FORM_SUCCESS then
 show_error('9163');
 if :ctrl_blk.drive_date is not null then
 :GLOBAL.ddate:=to_char(:ctrl_blk.drive_date,'mm-dd-rr');
 :GLOBAL.drive_type:=:ctrl_blk.s_drive_type;
 do_key('clear_form');
 :ctrl_blk.drive_date:=to_date(:GLOBAL.ddate,'mm-dd-rr');
 :ctrl_blk.s_drive_type:=:GLOBAL.drive_type;
 go_item('ctrl_blk.drive_id');
 end if;
 
 --check_package_failure;
 
 :system.message_level := 0;
 END IF;
end;
